newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Egyptian business delegation to visit Israel.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian business delegation to visit Israel.

text.p: Leading Egyptian businessman Ibrahim Kamel, chairman of the Kato group of companies, will head a three-man delegation visiting Israel on Monday, a source involved in the visit said.

Kamel would be joined by Mansour Al-Tarzi, a banker and chairman of Al-Mal Financial and Investment group, and Taher Helmy, a partner in the Egyptian office of the U.S. law firm Baker & McKenzie, the source said.
They will be visiting as guests of Benjamin Gaon, president and chief executive officer of Koor Industries KOR.N, who invited Kamel during November's Cairo economic summit, the source said.
The three will be in Israel for 24 hours, meeting Koor management and visiting Tadiran Ltd TAD.TA TAD.N and Nesher Cement on Monday.
On Tuesday, they will meet Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Foreign Minister David Levy and Finance Minister Dan Meridor. They will also meet Israeli business leaders.
The Kato group has interests in aviation, agriculture, tourism, property, insurance, banking and trade. Kamel also serves on a number of government authorities.
